events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, best known for 'Monty Python' and 'Fawlty Towers', celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: A Life in Comedy
angles.copy: From the Dead Parrot sketch to Basil Fawlty, John Cleese has given us some of the most enduring comedy moments. What's your favourite?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their eclectic double LP, 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece or a sign of things to come?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks the 35th anniversary of the death of Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Evolution
angles.copy: 'Rubber Soul' turns 61! The album that saw The Beatles evolve their sound, influencing countless artists. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who was fatally shot on December 8, 1980, in New York City.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world lost John Lennon. His music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating a Starman
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of David Bowie. His influence on music, fashion, and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have turned 92 today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Ninety-two years since the birth of Elvis Presley. His impact on music and popular culture is eternal.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page, born on January 9, 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday.

angles.name: Guitar God at 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped a generation of rock music. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, born on January 10, 1945, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young at 82
angles.copy: Eighty-two years young! Happy Birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart, still rocking stages worldwide.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Nutty Boy at 66
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs! The voice of Madness, bringing us joy and 'Our House' for decades.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat (That's My Home)', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Smooth Operator at 71
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! Still got that soulful voice that defined the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music legend, businesswoman, and philanthropist Dolly Parton, born on January 19, 1946, celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Queen of Country at 81
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true icon of music, kindness, and glamour.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer, and songwriter Gary Barlow, born on January 20, 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday.

angles.name: Rule The World at 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, a true British music institution.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen at 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to Billy Ocean! Still bringing sunshine with his timeless soul and R&B hits.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction anniversary
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 23, 1986, honouring pioneers like Elvis Presley, Chuck Berry, and Little Richard.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: Remembering the inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction from 1986. Which legendary artists do you think should be inducted next?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born on January 27, 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday.

angles.name: Take That's Mark Owen at 55
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Mark Owen! Celebrating the Take That star's enduring career.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their iconic and final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: An Iconic Final Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' legendary rooftop concert! A moment etched in music history. What's your favourite live Beatles track?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: British music icon Phil Collins, known for his solo hits and work with Genesis, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Up 76 Years
angles.copy: Happy 76th Birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true force in music, from Genesis to global solo stardom.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, born on January 31, 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday.

angles.name: Pop Prince at 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to pop superstar and actor.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure at 87
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has brought us so much laughter and joy.

events.title: Anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash on February 3, 1959.

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Remembering their enduring musical legacy.
